research_requirements: Choose exactly one tool per day.
Check history.json and avoid exact duplicates and near-duplicates.
Use official product and pricing sources wherever possible.
State free-tier quotas and limits; never describe a paid-only product as free.
Verify official Android Google Play app link; explicitly say when no official app is verified.
Check Pakistan signup, regional availability and payment restrictions when verifiable.
Include credible quality evidence; never invent benchmarks, ratings or performance claims.
Include official website, direct try/use link, date checked and concise verdict.
If evidence is unavailable, say so clearly.
